_source: A Data Analytic Evaluation of Singapore Mahjong (259pp). Replaces an earlier table whose VALUES were guessed and wrong - 13 Wonders had 5 instead of 8, everything was capped at 5 when All-Terminal is 9 and All-Kong is 14, and Ping Wu was missing entirely. The unit name was not the problem. Old file kept as scoring.singapore.GUESS.json.bak - do not use.
_note: This is one documented ruleset. Section 2.6 of the source surveys real-table variation; see rules.singapore.json -> house_variations.

doubled_for: every opponent when the win is a Self-Draw
payout._note: On a discard, only the discarder pays the doubled amount; the other two pay standard. On a Self-Draw all three pay doubled. 13 Wonders always pays as a Self-Draw.

combinations.name: Chicken
combinations.desc: Mahjong with none of All-Pong, All-Chow, Ping Wu, Half-Color or Full-Color

combinations.name: All-Chow
combinations.desc: Four Chows plus an Eye, with restrictions - see rules.singapore.json

combinations.name: Half-Terminal
combinations.desc: Every set contains a Terminal or Honor

combinations.name: Ping Wu
combinations.desc: All-Chow AND no Flower or Animal Tiles held

combinations.name: Dragon Set
combinations.desc: Three Dragon sets. Wins WITHOUT Mahjong

combinations.name: 13 Wonders
combinations.desc: Wins WITHOUT Mahjong. Always paid as Self-Draw

combinations.name: All-Terminal
combinations.desc: Every set is Terminals or Honors. Stacks with All-Pong for 11

combinations.name: Eight Flower
combinations.desc: Wins WITHOUT Mahjong. Concealing the eighth triggers a Pay All Penalty

combinations.name: Wind Set
combinations.desc: Four Wind sets. Stacks with All-Pong for 14

events.name: Win with the Last Valid Tile

tiles_and_sets.name: Each Flower/Season matching the Player's Number
Each complete Flower Set or Season Set
Seven Flower Game
tiles_and_sets._note: individual Flower Fan does not also add

tiles_and_sets.name: Two Dragons and an Eye
tiles_and_sets._note: the two Dragon Pong Fan DO add, so 3 total

tiles_and_sets.name: Three Winds and an Eye
tiles_and_sets._note: Wind Pong Fan already included; does not add again

stacking._note: Fan is additive except where an entry says otherwise.

immediate_payouts._note: Paid on the spot by every opponent, independent of who wins. Values below assume Minimum Fan 1: halve them at Minimum Fan 0, double them at Minimum Fan 2. DOUBLE again if obtained from the initial 13 tiles before any replacement.

_definitions.flower_pair: two Flower Tiles matching the Player's Flower Number

_unit_note: Fan (番) and tai (台) are the same unit - one doubling. Different dialects: fan is Mandarin/Cantonese, tai is Hokkien. Singapore tables use both names interchangeably. This file says Fan only because the source does.
